name: MacBook Pro 2021 built-in three-mic array
kind: beamforming MEMS array ('studio-quality'), no published frequency response
connection: Built-in. Set Control Center > Mic Mode to Standard (no Voice Isolation).
placement: Lid open, laptop at ear height on a stand, screen facing the speakers; the body causes reflections.
notes: APPROXIMATE, VERIFY: expect bass roll-off below ~100 Hz and beamforming coloration.
Only useful to compare EQ iterations against each other, never as an absolute reference.
